shared_elements: elongated vertical body with radiating/fringed element at the top (headdress-like)
justification: The only plausible correspondence is that both surfaces may present a single anthropomorphic figure orientated vertically with some kind of crest or fringed element above the head, which is about as generic as figural imagery gets. B depicts a fully naturalistic, three-dimensional man with modelled musculature, body markings, sash, and two trophy-head-like objects held in raised and lowered hands, none of which can be matched in A, whose pecked marks are schematic, linear and lack any identifiable attributes, limbs or handled objects.
